chunk-dv9ctjss.js decides what happens to a message from another
session before it reaches the queue: accept, hold until the permission
mode can be resolved, or refuse when the session opted out or the
kill switch is on. inboundGate.ts ports that subsystem whole, with the
held list, the receipts to the peer and the shutdown that settles
every held message as expired. The registrations the inbox server
needs (anr, lnr, dbt) are here.

inboxState.ts gains the accessors the server and the status line read
(Pqo, Oqo, oEn with RVt, sEn, Hqo, iEn, Mqo, Dqo, m9r).

Built through headless-pool with worktree isolation (two verified
items, disjoint). Annulling the self-sent accept, the expiry at
shutdown and the refuse cause each fails exactly its own cases.
